Republican Senator Lindsey Graham announced that the White House has approved the final version of the bill and is ready to support it. “About 30 minutes ago, we reached an agreement with the White House on a version of the bill on sanctions against Russia that they will support. This means it will become law,” Graham said. According to the senator, the new bill will give U.S. President Donald Trump the authority to impose additional sanctions and tariffs on countries that continue to purchase Russian oil, gas, and other energy resources.
